title: A data structure for quotient flag complexes
summary: Vietoris-Rips filtrations, which are standard in topological data analysis, are flag complexes, and a simplex tree stores these without any attaching data. In this paper we ask what survives of this economy when a flag complex $K$ is divided by a subcomplex $A$, each connected component of $A$ being crushed to a point. Such a quotient is a CW complex whose cells are the simplices of $K\setminus A$, but their attaching maps are no longer implicit.
